description: This file defines a set of interfaces related to data flow and grain processing in an Orleans-based distributed system. It includes interfaces for data sources, targets, processors, and propagators that facilitate message passing and processing workflows.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Marks the completion of data flow processing.

methods.name: Fault
methods.description: Signals a fault or error in processing.

methods.name: Completion
methods.description: Indicates the completion status of the grain.

methods.name: OfferMessage
methods.description: Offers a message to the target grain with an option to consume it to accept.

methods.name: SendAsync
methods.description: Sends a message asynchronously to the target.

methods.name: ConsumeMessage
methods.description: Consumes a message from the source.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the processor with the provided processor instance.

methods.name: ReceiveAll
methods.description: Receives all messages or outputs from the propagator.

methods.name: LinkTo
methods.description: Links the source grain to a target grain.
